title: 第3章 活尸围城第4章 双生炎骨
lines: 随着林战的话音落下，祖祠方向传来龙吟般的剑鸣。
一柄缠绕赤焰的古剑破空而来，剑柄处镶嵌的宝石正与林战护心镜产生共鸣。
当他的手掌触碰到剑柄时，往生镜碎片突然全部飞入剑身，
剑脊上浮现出九重青铜巨门的图案。
赤霄剑...
大长老的魔化躯体突然僵住，骨尾惊恐地缩回体内，
这把剑应该早就...
不错，在大长老的印象中，焚天剑早已消失不见，
可是此时不知为何林战竟然能够将焚天剑召唤出来！
大长老的话还未说完，产床上的婴儿突然发出震耳欲聋的啼哭。
往生镜碎片从剑身飞出，在林战周围组成星光大阵。
他福至心灵地挥剑斩向虚空，剑锋划过之处竟然裂开空间裂缝，
露出里面缓缓旋转的火焰轮盘。
原来九狱焚天塔的钥匙...
林战看着怀中婴儿，突然泪流满面，
竟然就是九狱炎骨本身。
魔化的大长老突然化作赤色流星撞向裂缝，
却在触及火焰轮盘的瞬间灰飞烟灭。
他的惨叫声中混杂着癫狂大笑：
老夫看到了！
塔顶的第九重门上刻着...
声音戛然而止。
林战抱着婴儿跪倒在地，他看见妻子消散的残魂化作荧光，
在儿子额头留下冰晶般的吻痕。
往生镜碎片重新嵌入焚天剑，剑身上的青铜门图案却永远缺失了最后一道。
当第一缕晨光刺破赤云时，整座天炎城寂静无声。
百姓们呆滞地望着林家祖宅方向——那里伫立着高达百丈的赤金剑影，
剑锋上缠绕的九道凤纹正在缓缓消散。
而在千里之外的北域血魔窟，九盏魂灯突然同时熄灭，
石壁上浮现出火焰轮盘的图腾。
产房外的槐树阴影里，萧三爷的指尖正在渗血。
他死死咬住后槽牙，看着倒映在叶片上的魔化长老被焚天剑斩灭的画面，
袖中玉简已经记录下第九段影像。
还不够...必须让所有人看到天罚...
没想到这林家大长老这么废物，竟然没能够成功！
他默念咒诀，三只影鸦从袖口钻出，猩红眼珠里倒映着正在融化的侍卫。
三爷！
东侧院墙...
随从话音未落，突然捂住喉咙跪倒在地。
他的瞳孔逐渐被黑雾吞噬，皮肤下凸起蚯蚓状的纹路——这是影鸦反噬的征兆。
萧三爷面无表情地拧断随从脖颈，将尸体抛向正在凝结的赤骨骷髅：
content_en:
As Lin Zhan finished speaking, a dragon-like sword cry came from the direction of the ancestral temple.
An ancient sword entwined with red flames came through the air, and the gems inlaid on the hilt resonated with Lin Zhan's breast mirror.
When his palm touched the hilt of the sword, all the fragments of the Mirror of Rebirth suddenly flew into the sword body.
The pattern of a nine-layered bronze gate appeared on the spine of the sword.
Red Sky Sword...
The great elder's demonized body suddenly froze, and his bone tail retracted into his body in horror.
This sword should have long been...
Yes, in the Great Elder’s impression, the Burning Sky Sword has long since disappeared.
But at this time, I don't know why Lin Zhan was able to summon the Burning Sky Sword!
Before the great elder finished speaking, the baby on the delivery bed suddenly let out a deafening cry.
The fragments of the Mirror of Rebirth flew out from the sword body and formed a starlight array around Lin Zhan.
He was so blessed that he swung his sword into the void, and a crack in the space opened where the sword edge passed.
Revealing the slowly rotating flame wheel inside.
It turns out that the key to the Nine Hells Burning Sky Tower...
Lin Zhan looked at the baby in his arms and suddenly burst into tears.
It turned out to be the Nine Hell Flame Bone itself.
The demonized Great Elder suddenly turned into a red meteor and crashed into the crack.
But the moment it touched the flame roulette, it vanished into ashes.
His screams were mixed with manic laughter:
I saw it!
Engraved on the ninth door at the top of the tower is...
The sound stopped suddenly.
Lin Zhan knelt down with the baby in his arms. He saw his wife's dissipated remnant soul turning into fluorescent light.
He left an ice-crystal kiss on his son's forehead.
The fragments of the Mirror of Rebirth were re-embedded into the Burning Heaven Sword, but the last line of the bronze door pattern on the sword was forever missing.
When the first ray of morning light pierced the red clouds, the entire Tianyan City was silent.
The common people looked blankly in the direction of the Lin family's ancestral home - there stood a hundred-foot-tall red gold sword shadow.
The nine phoenix patterns wrapped around the sword's edge are slowly dissipating.
Thousands of miles away in the Blood Demon Cave in the Northern Territory, nine soul lamps suddenly went out at the same time.
The totem of the Flame Roulette appeared on the stone wall.
In the shadow of the locust tree outside the delivery room, Mr. Xiao's fingertips were bleeding.
He gritted his back molars and looked at the image of the demonized elder being killed by the Burning Sky Sword reflected on the leaves.
The jade slip in the sleeve has recorded the ninth image.
It's not enough... Heaven's punishment must be seen by everyone...
I didn't expect that the eldest elder of the Lin family was such a loser that he could not succeed!
He recited the incantation silently, and three shadow crows emerged from the cuffs, their scarlet eyes reflecting the melting guards.
Third Master!
The east side courtyard wall...
Before he finished speaking, the follower suddenly covered his throat and fell to his knees.
His pupils were gradually swallowed up by the black mist, and earthworm-like lines protruded under his skin - this was a sign of the Shadow Crow's backlash.
Mr. Xiao expressionlessly broke the neck of his entourage and threw the body towards the congealing red-bone skeleton:
title_en: Chapter 3: Siege of the Living Corpses Chapter 4: Twin Flame Bones
